items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Later on after I met Count Basie and Art Tatum, Buck showed me a run that Art Tatum - it was his famous run.

ctx.x: Someone told me her age while she was there, but she was getting well known among musicians because she could really sing and she got herself a movie. The strange thing about it, with all the great pianists around including Sleepy - you know he's the type of pianist that played like Art Tatum in B natural and A natural, exactly like him.
But only in B natural and A natural?
